name: Editorial Design
what_it_means: Editorial design borrows from print magazines and newspapers: expressive serif headlines, multi-column text, drop caps, pull quotes, captions and rules. It treats the web page as a crafted spread, prioritising reading rhythm and storytelling over app-like components.
signature_moves: Multi-column body, drop caps, pull quotes
Thin rules, issue numbers, bylines, captions
Mix of serif display + clean sans for meta
best_for: Blogs, publications, long-form stories, brand journals
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a long-form article page for [PUBLICATION] in a print-magazine Editorial style. Warm paper background (#F4EFE6), ink text (#1A1A1A), one red accent (#B23A2B). Masthead with issue number and date separated by thin rules. Headline in a high-contrast serif (Playfair Display, 80px, tight leading) with an italic deck below. Body text in 3 columns with a large drop cap, a pull quote breaking across columns, and a full-bleed photo with a small caption. Bylines and section labels in a small letter-spaced sans-serif. No cards, no rounded corners, no shadows.
